title: Just in Thyme | Gulf View 30A Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Just In Thyme offers a private pool, pet friendly comfort, bikes, and wraparound balconies just 100 yards to the beach and steps from Seaside.
description_expanded: Just In Thyme Features - 100 Yards to Dogwood/Thyme Beach Access. Beach service available at this location - 2 min bike ride to Seaside shopping and dining, including the famous Seaside Food Trucks - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Private Plunge Pool - can be heated for an additional fee for arrivals October through April - Access to 6 Taxi bikes included with your stay - Fenced-in backyard with paved sundeck and poolside lounge chairs - Outdoor grill on the pool deck - Catch a glimpse of the Gulf from the 3rd floor balcony - Wraparound balconies on the 2nd and 3rd floor - 1 Min Walk to the Beach, 5 Minute Walk to Seaside for shopping and dining - Large Covered patio with enclosed outdoor shower, ping pong table, and outdoor dining - Main living area on the 2nd floor with full kitchen, dining area, and living area with TV and DVD player - Dining area with seating for 10 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 - 3rd Floor Den with dining table for 4, cushioned seating, wet bar, mini fridge, and TV - 2nd floor laundry room with washer and dryer - Driveway Parking for 4 Cars. RVs, Trailers, and street parking prohibited - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, golf cart rentals, beach service, and baby equipment rentals - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Best in location and comfort, Just In Thyme will be your family's new favorite vacation home. Nestled among gorgeous Magnolia Trees for a peaceful atmosphere, this 3000 square foot home is only 100 yards to the Dogwood/Thyme Beach Entrance and a 5-minute stroll (or 2-minute bike ride) to the center of Seaside with lots of shopping and dining options. This home is also loaded with amenities to ensure you have everything you need for a wonderful 30A vacation experience including a fenced in backyard with private pool and outdoor game room. Area Construction - Due to the outstanding beaches and amazing communities along 30A, our area is getting more popular each year. There is a high possibility of nearby construction, home remodels, community changes and county projects on the roads and bridges along 30A year-round and throughout every single community. Please be aware that refunds will not be issued due to noise disturbance or unsightly views due to nearby projects. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor Bunk Nook with Twin bunk (sleeps 2) | TV and DVD player, built-in ladder and guard rail on top bunk, hallway access to adjacent full bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Suite 1 | TV, private entrance to wrap around balcony, dresser and closet storage, ensuite bath with vanity sink and walk-in shower featuring bench seating
2nd Floor Bunk Room with two sets of Twin over Twin Bunks (sleeps 4) | TV, closet and dresser storage, adjacent to full bath with combination shower/tub
3rd Floor King Suite 2 | TV, walk-in closet and dresser storage, private access to Gulf facing wrap around balcony, ensuite bath with his and hers vanity sinks plus jetted tub and walk-in shower
3rd Floor Queen Room 1 | TV, dresser and closet storage, adjacent to full bath with walk-in shower and vanity sink
3rd Floor Queen Suite | 2 Queen Beds (sleeps 4), private entrance to wrap around balcony, Gulf view from bed! TV, dresser and closet storage, ensuite bath with walk-in shower

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
